positions.title: Experience Designer – Design Systems
positions.description:
Designing and building DLS – the Airbnb design language system – that supports 300+ designers and multiple businesses. 

On this team I worked on redesigning the search filter interface for the main Airbnb product to make it more accessible, user friendly, and to allow us to extend into multiple product tiers in the future.

While on this team I led the design of the Airbnb Developer site. This brought together all of the documentation and tools from every team at Airbnb into a central location. The goal was to significantly increase developer productivity. I led the design, coordinated teams, ran workshops, and ran research sessions.

positions.title: Experience Designer – Trust & Safety
positions.description:
Working on the Trust team focused on keeping the content on Airbnb authentic and safe for everyone. 

I led the design of the content moderation initiatives. This included revamping the user reporting flows across the product and designing the framework for verifying listings on Airbnb. These projects decreased incidents by 50% in 2017-2018. I planned the project, ran workshops, designed the interface, and helped run user testing sessions around the world.

positions.title: Design Manager
positions.description:
- Built and led a team of designers including brand and product designers
- Advocate for design with product, marketing, and sales.
- Created the levels and career paths for design hires
- Led the hiring process for mid and senior level designers.
- Managed mid and senior level designers
- Developed the design team process, including our design principles, critiques, stakeholder reviews, engineering handoff. Setup daily stand ups and critiques. 
- Led the product research and help create and see the vision for the product

positions.title: Design Lead
positions.description:
Over the years I worked on a large number of projects. Some of them were large product releases that involved the entire company and others were small projects to enable and unblock product, marketing, and sales.

Impact
- Led the design for many product launches over the years, including Organizations, Warehouses, Workspaces, Tracking Plan, and Sources.
- Led the design and implementation of the company rebrand in 2015.
- Designed many different versions of the marketing site over the 4 years as the company grew and shifted focus.
- Created the first version of the design system we called Evergreen. Developed the type scales, colors, interaction patterns and components.
- Led the redesign of the product a number of times over the years as the scope of the product expanded and the focus shifted.
- Ran the design on-boarding for all new company employees, introducing them to the team and the design process to help build a culture of design thinking.
- Developed the process for conducting user research to make it easier for teams to develop roadmaps, validate decisions, and conduct usability testing.

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description: I was the first employee and designer at Segment back in 2013. I built the design team to support Sales, Marketing, and Product. I was closely involved with the business and product strategy and processes as the company grew from the 4 founders with no revenue to nearly 200 employees and multiple funding rounds.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: Led the development of the frontend architecture for the new web platform.
